instruction: Read input.json and translate each source segment from source_locale to target_locale. Obey every required_glossary value as the required lexical choice and preserve every protected_tokens value exactly, including case, punctuation, digits, spaces, and UTC. Do not translate opaque identifiers. Write translation.json only. Output exactly schema_version, source_locale, target_locale, and translations. schema_version must be 1. translations must be an array in the same segment order; each entry must contain exactly id and text. Do not add explanations or any other file.
